# Uğur Dindar / PortfoCLI

> Uğur Dindar is a software engineer working across event-driven distributed systems, secure payments, and software for manufacturing operations. PortfoCLI is his multilingual portfolio.

The portfolio is available in English, Turkish, and German. Its experience, projects, and credentials are summarized from the English résumé PDF; the site’s profile and biography provide the corresponding online context.
